name: Analysis paragraphs contain inline citation markers
description: The analysis content should include inline citation markers such as [1], [2], or superscript numbers linking to a references section. At least one citation marker should appear in the visible analysis text.

planSteps.description: Click on any bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Scroll through the analysis panel to see inline citations
Verify that at least one inline citation marker is visible in the analysis text. This could appear as [1], [2], superscript numbers, or similar citation notation within the paragraphs.
